documents.text: Action is the integer vector of desired unit allocations to three candidate strategies; each coordinate is zero through three. Each unit encumbers two capital units. documents.text: An action is [A_release_units,B_sale_units,new_borrowing], nonnegative integers each at most eight. A release consumes 2 of A's collateral and gives central cash 1.6 immediately. B sale consumes 2 of B's collateral and generates 1.8 pending cash for the next round only. A and B balances may never be reduced below their current legal floors; a preexisting shortfall does not authorize further withdrawal. Total debt including borrowing cannot exceed eight. Each borrowing unit delivers 0.75 cash now and increases debt by one (the difference is its 0.25 fee). No inter-account netting, reuse of locked collateral, or early settlement is allowed. Integer quantities may be encoded as JSON integers or finite exactly integral JSON numbers (for example 3 and 3.0 are equivalent); booleans and fractional quantities are invalid. This quantity convention does not relax the integer response turn identifier. A rejected action does not execute a default or substitute action and does not change assets or cash. The submission still consumes the current round and the simulation then processes its normal inter-round events. In particular, rejection executes no payment: the entire current scheduled due is added to carried arrears, even if the unchanged cash balance could have paid part of it.
documents.title: Execution and evidence rules

documents.text: Payment due plus arrears is paid using central cash, leaving any unpaid remainder as carried arrears. Economic cash cost is 0.4*A_units + 0.2*B_units + 0.25*borrowing. The stated next-round due and scheduled central inflow are known contractual forecasts; the public terms contain those values. Violation equals current A-floor and B-floor shortfalls + central-cash shortfall below one + remaining arrears, plus before round four max(0,next_due+1-next_inflow-post_cash-pending). Minimize 1000*violation + cash cost + 0.1*resulting total debt. Diagnostic array is [central cash after current payment,remaining arrears,pending proceeds]. Scheduled inflows and pending proceeds arrive on advance. Floors are legal execution constraints; the liquidity forecast reserve is a policy constraint.

documents.text: Actions READ_A or READ_B purchase one previously unobserved binary signal at the public cost. The worlds table is the complete joint distribution of the two signals and the payoff of INVEST. Condition on every purchased observation; signals are correlated, so do not multiply marginal likelihoods. ABSTAIN gives zero payoff. INVEST or ABSTAIN is an irreversible terminal investment decision; all remaining rounds then require WAIT. Budget costs are paid immediately and never refunded. Signal observations become visible only after actual purchase. No action can use an unpurchased signal or the realized hidden world. Integer quantities may be encoded as JSON integers or finite exactly integral JSON numbers (for example 3 and 3.0 are equivalent); booleans and fractional quantities are invalid. This quantity convention does not relax the integer response turn identifier. A rejected action does not execute a default or substitute action and does not change assets or cash. The submission still consumes the current round and the simulation then processes its normal inter-round events.
documents.title: Execution and evidence rules

documents.text: Maximize expected future investment payoff minus all future signal costs, conditional on current observations and budget. A purchase consumes one round, and a final investment decision must fit in remaining rounds; hence no purchase in the last round. Bellman value of READ_X is -cost_X plus expected optimal continuation value over its conditional signal outcomes. INVEST value is conditional mean payoff; ABSTAIN value is zero. Objective is negative value of the selected action under optimal continuation. Transaction cost is the immediate purchase cost. title: Adaptive purchase of correlated costly evidence

documents.text: Action is [verb,quantity], verb WAIT,CANCEL,BUY or SELL. WAIT/CANCEL quantity is zero. BUY/SELL quantity is an integer one through ten. No new order or sale while an earlier buy is live. SELL cannot exceed confirmed inventory; proceeds less the fee are unsettled pending cash until next round. BUY pays fee 2 immediately and reserves quantity*buy_price; after this reservation cash must be at least 150. A cancellation request leaves the buy live until next-round acknowledgement, and up to two additional lots can fill first. A second cancellation while pending is rejected. Live buys that are not cancelled can fill on advance. Trade corrections and target revisions, when received, affect the actual book. Do not presume an unreceived correction. Integer quantities may be encoded as JSON integers or finite exactly integral JSON numbers (for example 3 and 3.0 are equivalent); booleans and fractional quantities are invalid. This quantity convention does not relax the integer response turn identifier. A rejected action does not execute a default or substitute action and does not change assets or cash. The submission still consumes the current round and the simulation then processes its normal inter-round events.
documents.title: Execution and evidence rules

documents.text: Minimize 10*worst_target_deviation + current fee + 0.1*remaining live quantity + 1000*reserve_shortfall. In every round, any remaining live buy creates a projected confirmed inventory range from inventory after the proposed action to that inventory plus live buy quantity, or plus min(2,live) if cancellation is pending. This includes a preexisting live order in the final round. Worst deviation is the max absolute difference of these two endpoints from the target. In the last round new buys fill immediately; sales still create pending proceeds. A final-round cancellation of a preexisting live order remains pending: there is no subsequent advance or cancellation acknowledgement, so a terminal requirement for no live orders may be unattainable from that book. Diagnostic array is [cash minus full remaining live-buy commitments,worst target deviation,pending sale proceeds]. Reserve shortfall is max(0,150-cash_after_full_commitments). Pending cash cannot fund buys. BUY reserves but does not spend principal until fill; SELL fee is netted from pending proceeds. The supplied current book is authoritative after all received fills, acknowledgements, settlements, or corrections.
